 ‘Lexi Con’ podcast subject, accused of faking cancer, arrested on Howard theft charges 
 Indictment covers 2016 to 2019 and names 25 alleged victims; Alexandra ‘Lexi’ Thomas’ husband separately seeks to annul their marriage

 By Matthew Wynn | mwynn@baltsun.com and Bryna Zumer PUBLISHED: November 19, 2026 at 4:58 PM EST | UPDATED: November 19, 2026 at 6:03 PM EST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... Alexandra “Lexi” Thomas, 34, is being held without bond. GoFundMe says it is investigating, and the indictment lists her sister and brother-in-law among the alleged victims.
